selection: inner LOSO: unknown rejection >= C0, known acceptance loss <= 1 percentage point, stable AUC/F1 trend, worst identity not worse; maximize known acceptance

temporal_split.inner_calibration: held identity unknown and remaining identities known, 0.4 < frac <= 0.6
temporal_split.evaluation: outer held identity and known identities, frac > 0.8

identity_decision: top-1 strict LDA-cos; refusal score never changes ranking
threshold: identity-balanced weighted FAR10 from inner pseudo-unknown scores

gates.1: Train in-sample accuracy = 1.00 (fitted on all 20 identities, frac <= 0.6, evaluated on the same rows)
gates.4: forward block-out accuracy >= 0.90 (fit frac <= 0.6, evaluate frac > 0.6)
gates.6: U@95% >= 0.95 (strict; inner LOSO, threshold = quantile of known 0.4 < frac <= 0.6 at 0.95)
gates.7: RA worst over the SNR30 x goal conditions >= 0.95 (SNR20 reported as reference)
gates.8: ASafeR worst over the same conditions >= 0.98
gates.11: strict LOSO unknown rejection at a=0.90 > 0.90

attack.subset: Train 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, cap 400 per task, seed 20261115
attack.radius: per-trial L2 norm of the demeaned waveform / 10^(SNR/20)
attack.goals: A/B/C maximise wrong-vs-true identity margin; D maximises the refusal gate (E195 gate-evasion)
attack.gradient: Daleckii-Krein SPD matrix-log backward; the torch.linalg.eigh NaN on repeated eigenvalues is removed
